analyst.summary: EPL is the world's largest maker of laminated plastic tubes -- the packaging used for toothpaste, cosmetics and pharma products -- supplying global brands like Colgate, P&G, Unilever and GSK from over 20 plants worldwide. Ownership quality improved after Blackstone took a large stake in 2019-2020, stabilizing what had been an over-leveraged promoter group. Growth has been steady rather than exciting (revenue up about 13% in the last year), and the most recent quarter showed profit decline slightly even as revenue grew, a margin point worth watching. The stock is reasonably, not richly, valued for the steadiness of the business. We rate it a Hold: solid, well-governed packaging supplier to blue-chip FMCG clients, priced fairly for its moderate growth rate.
